rv.q: Taking an instant dislike to the woman he had come to meet, he falls in love with Chava (also played by the actress who plays Eva), a beautiful 21-year-old young woman who works at a hat shop he sees through the store window. Unfortunately, she is a studious type preparing for Warsaw college entrance exams in philosophy and has no time for marriage.
That relationship is spun out modestly and pleasingly, and the right songs show up in the right places.

cn.t: Critics find this charming two-character musical about a Jewish man's old-country quest for a wife to be a sweet, affectionate romance, though it treads familiar territory for the intimate 59E59 stage.

vr.q: deeply romantic very funny and extremely timely
